title: Record feed: the reaction chip removes the caller's own reaction through the unreact door, so a member with no delete grant can take a reaction back (ui half of #26161)
body:
Filed by the `domain:server` seat 1, the holding seat of #26161, as the ruling there directs: "The server card lands first; the holding seat files the `domain:ui` sub-card with `Blocked-by:` this card" (ruling `6422861164`, letter A, maintainer 「同意」 2026-10-26T17:27Z). ⛔ Not a claim.

Part of #26161
Blocked-by: #26161
Ruling-ref: 6422861164

**Symptom.** A member who holds no position can add a comment reaction but never take it back. The console's reaction chip removes through the generic `DELETE /api/v1/data/sys_comment_reaction/:id`, which needs an object-level `delete` grant. No every-member set may carry that grant (ADR-0090 D5, `security-anchor-high-privilege`), so the chip offers no remove at all: `feedReactionRemove` reads a `delete` grant.

**The server half (PR #26345, #26161).** `AuditPlugin` mounts an own-row unreact door:

`DELETE /api/v1/comments/reactions/:id`, where `:id` is the `sys_comment_reaction` row id. It reads no body, and any query parameter is refused. Answers:
- `200` `{ success: true, data: { id, deleted: true } }`: the caller's own reaction is removed;
- `400 VALIDATION_ERROR`: a query parameter, or no id;
- `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`;
- `403` with a held sign-in's own code;
- `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`: another member's reaction, which stays;
- `404 RECORD_NOT_FOUND`: no such row, or one the caller cannot read;
- `503 SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE`.

`@objectstack/client` has no method for it yet.

**The UI half (this card, ui S):**
- The reaction chip (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/RecordDetailView.tsx`, `reactionRemove` near `:435`) removes the caller's own reaction through the new route instead of the generic data door.
- `feedReactionRemove` in `ui/packages/core/src/utils/affordanceGrants.ts:213` stops reading a `delete` grant on `sys_comment_reaction`. Every member who may react may take back their own reaction, so the affordance is "this reaction is mine" (`created_by` is the caller), not a grant. Update the affordance pins (`RecordDetailView.feedGrant-12082.test.tsx`, `affordanceGrantMap-12082.test.tsx`) to match.
- If a client method is wanted, adding one to `@objectstack/client` (with its route-ledger row) belongs here too.

**Done when:** as a plain member with `member_default` and no position, in the console, add a reaction and click your own chip to remove it (`200`, and the chip goes away). Another member's chip offers no remove. A member with a `delete` grant sees the same behaviour.
